# Keep a draft's deadline steady through repeated recovery-setting changes

## What & Why
A draft notice now keeps the recovery window that was selected when it was dismissed. A regression test should also cover changing the preference more than once before that notice expires, so repeated settings changes cannot move its countdown or deadline.

## Done looks like
- An answer notice and an opportunity notice remain tied to their original dismissal deadlines after multiple preference changes.
- Their countdowns and expiration announcements remain accurate throughout the sequence.
